interpretation: Authored capability progression, checked against source links. Changed constraints are task variations, not observed independent transfer. Numerical activities are browser-reported practice; rationales and external work require self-review or later human review.
helpContract: Existing exercises keep staged hints and full solutions. New experiments preserve first outcomes and help through reset and offer a changed case. Revisited reference material is recorded as assistance.
